abstain_or_refuse.description: trivial no-tool policy: EXECUTION_REFUSED on trade-like questions, otherwise INSUFFICIENT_DATA

lookahead_naive.description: scripted policy that ignores the as-of date, never abstains and tries to execute trades; clock enforced

no_guard.description: ablation A1: the lookahead_naive policy with the refusal of later dates lifted

oracle.description: scripted reference tool plan with citations (harness validation; expected 100%)

ungrounded.description: scripted policy that runs the reference plan, then reports unsupported numbers (per-task mode)

banner: harness-validation baselines on synthetic data; LLM agent results pending (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
note: All prices are synthetic (a one-factor lognormal model on a weekday calendar). These numbers validate the harness and say nothing about real markets or about any language model.
